FACT-1.gloss: Jill earns $20 per hour as a teacher (teaching job's rate is 20)

FACT-2.gloss: Jill works 35 hours per week teaching

FACT-3.gloss: Jill earns $30 per hour as a cheerleading coach (coaching job's rate is 30)

FACT-4.gloss: Jill works 15 hours per week coaching

FACT-5.gloss: There are 50 weeks in a year

RULE-1.gloss: For any job, the weekly earning equals the hourly rate multiplied by the weekly hours

RULE-2.gloss: Jill's total weekly earning is the sum of the weekly earnings from her two jobs

RULE-3.gloss: Jill's annual salary equals her total weekly earning multiplied by the number of weeks in a year
